ceo.notes: CSV for QIWI contains no person name or position. Alexey Mashchenkov is included in ceo because official company sources identify him as CEO in the 2024 context. Other board members and executives identified in official sources were not added to tmt because they were absent from the CSV. No confirmed publications, patents, research roles, ORCID/Scopus/eLIBRARY/Google Scholar profile, or h-index were found. St. Petersburg State University field and graduation year were not confirmed. Harvard AMP is treated as executive education, not a degree. QUALITY PASS (2026-07-31): desync check found no simple omissions and no genuine notes-vs-JSON inconsistencies (single research round, already internally consistent). GICS correctness audit corrected 3 mislabeled professional_experience entries: QIWI CEO and CFO roles were Consumer Finance, changed to the generic Financial Services (New Name) row to match QIWI's confirmed payment-service-provider business (not consumer lending) and the company-level GICS already recorded in this file; the Alpcot Capital Management / Agrokultura / Alpcot Agro entry was Capital Markets, changed to Food Products because the specifically documented, dual-sourced CFO title was at Agrokultura/Alpcot Agro, an agricultural producer (the entry's own name and already-cited prospectus confirm this), not at the asset-manager side of the bundled organization name. Gap follow-up filled 3 of 4 previously all-null professional_experience GICS triples with fresh sources (Russian Fishery -> Food Products via ru.wikipedia.org; PwC and Bain & Company -> Professional Services via en.wikipedia.org for both firms; OAO MegaFon -> Wireless Telecommunication Services via ru.wikipedia.org). Russian Standard / Русский Стандарт remains null after a fresh Interfax re-check confirmed the role was CFO of the diversified 'Русский Стандарт' group of companies (spanning an unrelated bank and vodka business), so no single GICS industry could be confidently assigned; documented rather than guessed.

Conflicts remaining: CSV has no person row while official 2024 sources identify Alexey Mashchenkov as CEO; final ceo is filled because the schema asks for confirmed CEO, while tmt remains empty due the CSV restriction.
